name: Global Cypher Query Contract
description: Mandatory rules the Cypher agent must apply to EVERY generated query against the Worktual OKG. Retrieve and prepend this card on every request.

name: Contact History Traversal (collection nodes)
description: A Contact does not connect directly to its Conversations, Interactions, Activities, Insights or Recommendations. Each hangs off a synthetic collection node keyed by the same cdp_id. Every 'show me everything about customer X' query must go through the collection hop.
cypher_template: MATCH (ct:Contact {cdp_id: $cdp_id})-[:HAS_CONVERSATIONS]->(:ConversationHistory)-[:CONTAINS]->(c:Conversation) RETURN c.id AS conversation_id, c.channel AS channel, c.status AS status, c.created_at AS created_at, c.resolved_at AS resolved_at ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 20

name: Missed Contacts
description: A contact that was offered to a specific agent and not answered. Materialised as its own MissedContact node with reason, channel, offered_at and missed_at.
cypher_template: MATCH (mc:MissedContact) WHERE mc.missed_at >= datetime($period_start) AND mc.missed_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN count(mc) AS missed_count

name: Routing Failure / No Agent Available
description: Attempts by the router to place a conversation with an agent, and their outcomes. Used for capacity and coverage questions, not for agent-level missed contacts.
cypher_template: MATCH (ra:RoutingAttempt) WHERE ra.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND ra.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN ra.outcome AS outcome, count(ra) AS attempts, count(DISTINCT ra.conversation_id) AS conversations ORDER BY attempts DESC

name: Abandonment Rate
description: Share of conversations where the customer disconnected before any agent was assigned.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND c.created_at < datetime($period_end) WITH count(c) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN c.assigned_at IS NULL AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abandoned RETURN abandoned, total, CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE round(100.0 * abandoned / total, 2) END AS abandonment_pct

name: SLA Breach Rate
description: Conversations whose service level deadline was missed, recorded as SLAInstance.breached_at.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:HAS_SLA]->(si:SLAInstance) WHERE si.breached_at >= datetime($period_start) AND si.breached_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN count(si) AS breach_count

name: First Contact Resolution (FCR)
description: Conversations resolved without any transfer to another queue or agent.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.resolved_at >= datetime($period_start) AND c.resolved_at < datetime($period_end) WITH count(c) AS resolved, sum(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS { (c)-[:HAS_TRANSFER]->(:Transfer) } THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fcr RETURN fcr, resolved, CASE WHEN resolved = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE round(100.0 * fcr / resolved, 2) END AS fcr_pct

name: Average Handle Time (AHT)
description: Average elapsed seconds from agent assignment to resolution.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.resolved_at >= datetime($period_start) AND c.resolved_at < datetime($period_end) AND c.assigned_at IS NOT NULL RETURN round(avg(duration.inSeconds(c.assigned_at, c.resolved_at).seconds)) AS aht_seconds, count(c) AS sample_size

name: Service Level
description: Share of conversations whose first agent response landed inside the first-response SLA deadline.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:HAS_SLA]->(si:SLAInstance) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND c.created_at < datetime($period_end) WITH count(c) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN c.first_agent_response_at IS NOT NULL AND c.first_agent_response_at <= si.first_response_due_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS met RETURN met, total, CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE round(100.0 * met / total, 2) END AS service_level_pct

name: Queue Wait Time
description: Elapsed seconds from entering the queue to agent assignment.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:IN_QUEUE]->(q:Queue) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND c.created_at < datetime($period_end) AND c.queued_at IS NOT NULL AND c.assigned_at IS NOT NULL RETURN q.name AS queue, round(avg(duration.inSeconds(c.queued_at, c.assigned_at).seconds)) AS avg_wait_seconds, count(c) AS sample_size ORDER BY avg_wait_seconds DESC LIMIT 10

name: Transfer Rate
description: Conversations transferred to another queue or agent, as a count and as a share of conversations in the period.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:HAS_TRANSFER]->(t:Transfer) WHERE t.requested_at >= datetime($period_start) AND t.requested_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS conversations_transferred, count(t) AS transfer_events

name: Conversation Volume
description: Count of conversations in a period, optionally split by channel, queue or status.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND c.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN c.channel AS channel, count(c) AS volume ORDER BY volume DESC

name: Interaction (CDP projection)
description: Interaction is the CDP-side projection of a CCaaS Conversation, carrying sentiment, outcome and summary for customer-360 use.
cypher_template: MATCH (i:Interaction) WHERE i.started_at >= datetime($period_start) AND i.started_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN i.sentiment AS sentiment, count(i) AS interactions ORDER BY interactions DESC

name: Support Agent
description: The Agent node is the contact-centre identity of a workforce Employee. Conversations attach to it via HANDLED_BY.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:HANDLED_BY]->(a:Agent) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND c.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN a.display_name AS agent, count(c) AS handled ORDER BY handled DESC LIMIT 10

name: Customer
description: A Contact who has bought. Available two ways: the :Customer sublabel set from contact_type, or a completed Order / SalesOrder.
cypher_template: MATCH (ct:Contact:Customer) RETURN count(ct) AS customer_count

name: Lead
description: A Contact in the pre-sale stage. Expressed two ways: the :Lead sublabel from contact_type, and the CRM overlay ContactProfile.lead_status.
cypher_template: MATCH (cp:ContactProfile)-[:OVERLAY_OF]->(ct:Contact) WHERE cp.lead_status IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS { (cp)-[:CONVERTED_TO]->(:Opportunity) } RETURN count(DISTINCT ct) AS open_lead_count

name: Churn Risk
description: Contacts with an elevated churn_score on their CustomerScore node.
cypher_template: MATCH (ct:Contact)-[:HAS_SCORES]->(cs:CustomerScore) WHERE cs.churn_score >= $threshold RETURN ct.cdp_id AS cdp_id, ct.first_name AS first_name, ct.last_name AS last_name, cs.churn_score AS churn_score, cs.updated_at AS scored_at ORDER BY cs.churn_score DESC LIMIT 20

name: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)
description: Total order value attributable to a contact.
cypher_template: MATCH (ct:Contact)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.status IN $paid_statuses RETURN ct.cdp_id AS cdp_id, ct.first_name AS first_name, ct.last_name AS last_name, o.currency AS currency, sum(toFloat(o.total_amount)) AS clv, count(o) AS orders ORDER BY clv DESC LIMIT 20

name: Segment Membership
description: Contacts belonging to a marketing or analytics segment.
cypher_template: MATCH (ct:Contact)-[:BELONGS_TO_SEGMENT]->(s:Segment) RETURN s.segment_name AS segment, count(DISTINCT ct) AS members ORDER BY members DESC

name: AI Insights and Recommendations
description: Model-generated insights and recommendations attached to a contact through collection nodes.
cypher_template: MATCH (ct:Contact {cdp_id: $cdp_id})-[:HAS_INSIGHTS]->(:InsightCollection)-[:CONTAINS]->(i:Insight) RETURN i.insight_type AS type, i.score AS score, i.summary AS summary, i.generated_at AS generated_at ORDER BY i.generated_at DESC LIMIT 10

name: Opportunity Pipeline
description: Sales opportunity pipeline with stages, forecast amounts, win rates and deal activities.
cypher_template: MATCH (d:Opportunity) WHERE d.closed_at IS NULL RETURN d.stage AS stage, count(d) AS deals, sum(toFloat(d.amount)) AS pipeline_value ORDER BY pipeline_value DESC

name: Account (Account)
description: Account is not a label. The organisational entity is Account, with AccountSite for individual locations.
cypher_template: MATCH (co:Account) RETURN co.industry AS industry, count(co) AS accounts ORDER BY accounts DESC

name: Revenue / Order Volume
description: Order value and count. Two separate stores: CDP Order (self-serve / commerce) and CRM SalesOrder (sales-led).
cypher_template: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND o.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN o.currency AS currency, count(o) AS order_count, sum(toFloat(o.total_amount)) AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC

name: Billing and Invoicing
description: Invoices issued to companies, and the contracts they recur under. There is no BillingCycle node — the cycle is inferred from Contract dates and Invoice issue dates.
cypher_template: MATCH (inv:Invoice)-[:FOR_ACCOUNT]->(co:Account) WHERE inv.issue_date >= date($period_start) AND inv.issue_date < date($period_end) RETURN co.name AS company, inv.currency AS currency, count(inv) AS invoices, sum(toFloat(inv.total)) AS billed ORDER BY billed DESC LIMIT 10

name: Product Catalog
description: Sellable inventory products, plus the CRM commercial overlays: offers, addons, tiers and price books.
cypher_template: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.status = $status RETURN p.category AS category, count(p) AS products, avg(toFloat(p.price)) AS avg_price ORDER BY products DESC

name: Period-over-Period Comparison
description: How to answer any 'did X go up or down' question in a single query.

name: Top Contributors Breakdown
description: How to rank dimensions by their contribution to a change.

name: Period-over-Period Comparison
description: Compare a metric between current period and previous period; calculate absolute and percentage delta.
cypher_template: WITH $period_start AS ps, $period_end AS pe, $compare_start AS cs, $compare_end AS ce RETURN ps, pe, cs, ce

name: Top Contributors Breakdown
description: Rank dimensions (queue, channel, outcome, agent) by contribution to period-over-period delta.

name: Campaign Send Volume
description: Count of CampaignDelivery rows that were successfully sent (status=sent) for a campaign or channel in a period.
cypher_template: MATCH (d:CampaignDelivery)-[:FOR_CAMPAIGN]->(c:Campaign) WHERE d.status = 'sent' AND d.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND d.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN count(d) AS sent_count

name: Campaign Open Rate
description: Share of sent CampaignDelivery rows that have at least one open (opened_at IS NOT NULL or open_count > 0).
cypher_template: MATCH (d:CampaignDelivery) WHERE d.status='sent' AND d.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND d.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN count(d) AS sent, sum(CASE WHEN d.opened_at IS NOT NULL OR d.open_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opened, toFloat(sum(CASE WHEN d.opened_at IS NOT NULL OR d.open_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / count(d) AS open_rate

name: Campaign Click Rate
description: Share of sent deliveries with at least one click (clicked_at IS NOT NULL or click_count > 0).
cypher_template: MATCH (d:CampaignDelivery) WHERE d.status='sent' AND d.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND d.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN count(d) AS sent, sum(CASE WHEN d.clicked_at IS NOT NULL OR d.click_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clicked, toFloat(sum(CASE WHEN d.clicked_at IS NOT NULL OR d.click_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / count(d) AS click_rate

name: Campaign Audience Size
description: Number of CDP Contacts included in a campaign audience at save/launch.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Campaign)-[:HAS_AUDIENCE_MEMBER]->(ct:Contact) WHERE c.id = $campaign_id RETURN count(ct) AS audience_size

name: Failed or Skipped Deliveries
description: CampaignDelivery rows with status failed or skipped; skip_fail_reason explains suppression, bounce, missing destination, etc.
cypher_template: MATCH (d:CampaignDelivery) WHERE d.status IN ['failed','skipped'] AND d.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND d.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN d.status AS status, d.skip_fail_reason AS reason, count(*) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

name: Email Unsubscribe and Suppression
description: Contacts or emails that must not receive campaign email — CampaignEngagement.email_unsubscribed and/or EmailSuppression rows.
cypher_template: MATCH (e:CampaignEngagement) WHERE e.email_unsubscribed = true RETURN count(e) AS unsubscribed_contacts

name: Email Channel Readiness
description: Whether the tenant email channel is ready to send — ChannelSendingProfile status=ready plus sender/domain/return-path/compliance/caps health.
cypher_template: MATCH (p:ChannelSendingProfile)-[:THROUGH]->(ch:Channel) WHERE ch.name = 'email' OR p.channel = 'email' RETURN p.status AS profile_status

name: Campaigns Received by Contact
description: All campaigns targeted to or delivered to a CDP Contact via the ReceivedCampaigns hub.
aliases: what campaigns did this contact get
cypher_template: MATCH (ct:Contact {cdp_id: $cdp_id})-[:HAS_RECEIVED_CAMPAIGNS]->(hub:ReceivedCampaigns)-[:CONTAINS]->(d:CampaignDelivery)-[:FOR_CAMPAIGN]->(c:Campaign) RETURN c.name AS campaign, d.status AS status, d.opened_at AS opened_at, d.clicked_at AS clicked_at ORDER BY d.created_at DESC

name: Anonymous vs Identified Visitor
description: WebsiteContacts mapped as Visitor. AnonymousVisitor when no CDP contact_id; IdentifiedVisitor when IDENTIFIED_AS Contact.
cypher_template: MATCH (v:Visitor) RETURN sum(CASE WHEN v.contact_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS anonymous, sum(CASE WHEN v.contact_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identified

name: A/B Variant Performance
description: Compare open/click/sent metrics across CampaignDelivery.ab_variant values (a, b, holdout, winner).
cypher_template: MATCH (d:CampaignDelivery)-[:FOR_CAMPAIGN]->(c:Campaign) WHERE c.id = $campaign_id AND d.status='sent' RETURN d.ab_variant AS variant, count(d) AS sent, sum(CASE WHEN d.opened_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opened, sum(CASE WHEN d.clicked_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clicked

name: Regulated Template Approval
description: Approval state of SMS/WhatsApp RegulatedTemplate required before regulated channel sends.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:RegulatedTemplate) WHERE t.status = $status RETURN t.channel AS channel, t.name AS name, t.status AS status, t.rejected_reason AS rejected_reason ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC

name: Campaign Lifecycle
description: Campaign.status lifecycle: draft → scheduled/live → completed/cancelled. source_channel is origin (standalone_campaign|crm_marketing), not a Channel node.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Campaign) RETURN c.status AS status, count(*) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

name: Campaign Channel Performance
description: Compare send/open/click/failure metrics across marketing channels for campaigns.
cypher_template: MATCH (d:CampaignDelivery)-[:THROUGH]->(ch:Channel) WHERE d.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND d.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN ch.name AS channel, count(d) AS deliveries, sum(CASE WHEN d.status='sent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sent, sum(CASE WHEN d.opened_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opened ORDER BY sent DESC

name: Open Tickets
description: Tickets whose status is not terminal (still being worked). Prefer CaseStatus.is_terminal = false over hardcoding status names.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase)-[:USES_STATUS]->(ts:CaseStatus) WHERE ts.is_terminal = false AND t.organization_id = $organization_id RETURN count(t) AS open_tickets

name: Overdue Tickets
description: Non-terminal tickets whose resolution deadline (SupportCase.due_at) is before now. due_at is computed from ServiceLevelPolicy by priority at create/update.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase)-[:USES_STATUS]->(ts:CaseStatus) WHERE ts.is_terminal = false AND t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < datetime() AND t.organization_id = $organization_id RETURN count(t) AS overdue_tickets

name: Unassigned Tickets
description: Open tickets with no L1 assignee (no ASSIGNED_TO StaffRole, or assignee_id null).
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase)-[:USES_STATUS]->(ts:CaseStatus) WHERE ts.is_terminal = false AND t.organization_id = $organization_id AND NOT (t)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:StaffRole) RETURN count(t) AS unassigned_tickets

name: Due Today Tickets
description: Open tickets whose due_at falls on the organization's local calendar today (OrgSettings.display_timezone).
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase)-[:USES_STATUS]->(ts:CaseStatus) WHERE ts.is_terminal = false AND t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND date(t.due_at) = date() AND t.organization_id = $organization_id RETURN count(t) AS due_today

name: SupportCase Volume
description: Count of tickets created in a period; optionally breakdown by channel, priority, or SupportQueue.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase) WHERE t.organization_id = $organization_id AND t.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND t.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN t.channel AS channel, count(t) AS volume ORDER BY volume DESC

name: Resolved Tickets
description: Tickets that reached a terminal status; prefer SupportCase.resolved_at or CaseStatus.is_terminal = true.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase) WHERE t.organization_id = $organization_id AND t.resolved_at >= datetime($period_start) AND t.resolved_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN count(t) AS resolved_tickets

name: SupportCase First Response Time
description: Time from ticket creation to first staff response (SupportCase.first_response_at). SLA target hours come from ServiceLevelPolicy.first_response_hours by priority.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase) WHERE t.organization_id = $organization_id AND t.first_response_at IS NOT NULL AND t.first_response_at >= datetime($period_start) AND t.first_response_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN avg(duration.between(t.created_at, t.first_response_at).seconds) AS avg_first_response_seconds

name: SupportCase Resolution Time
description: Duration from SupportCase.created_at to SupportCase.resolved_at for resolved tickets.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase) WHERE t.organization_id = $organization_id AND t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND t.resolved_at >= datetime($period_start) AND t.resolved_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN avg(duration.between(t.created_at, t.resolved_at).seconds) AS avg_resolution_seconds

name: SupportCase SLA Compliance
description: Share of resolved tickets that met resolution deadline (resolved_at <= due_at) or first-response deadline.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase) WHERE t.organization_id = $organization_id AND t.resolved_at >= datetime($period_start) AND t.resolved_at < datetime($period_end) AND t.due_at IS NOT NULL WITH count(t) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN t.resolved_at <= t.due_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS met RETURN met, total, toFloat(met)/total AS sla_compliance_rate

name: SupportCase CSAT
description: Customer satisfaction on tickets: SupportCase.csat_score (1–5) and csat_rated_at. Supports average, promoter/detractor rates, and response rate among resolved.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase) WHERE t.organization_id = $organization_id AND t.csat_score IS NOT NULL AND t.csat_rated_at >= datetime($period_start) AND t.csat_rated_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN avg(toFloat(t.csat_score)) AS average_csat, count(t) AS rated_count

name: SupportCase Escalation
description: Tickets escalated to an L2 resolver. Graph: SupportCase has RESOLVED_BY StaffRole and/or AuditEvent.action = ticket.escalated.
cypher_template: MATCH (ae:AuditEvent)-[:ON_TICKET]->(t:SupportCase) WHERE ae.organization_id = $organization_id AND ae.action = 'ticket.escalated' AND ae.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND ae.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN count(DISTINCT t) AS escalation_volume

name: SupportCase Queue Load
description: Workload on SupportQueue: open ticket count, assigned count, sla_status, and membership via HAS_MEMBER StaffRole.
cypher_template: MATCH (q:SupportQueue) WHERE q.organization_id = $organization_id OPTIONAL MATCH (t:SupportCase)-[:IN_QUEUE]->(q) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:USES_STATUS]->(ts:CaseStatus) WITH q, sum(CASE WHEN ts.is_terminal = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_live RETURN q.queue_name AS queue, open_live, q.open_tickets AS open_cached, q.sla_status AS sla_status ORDER BY open_live DESC

name: SupportCase Agent
description: StaffRole is the ticketing workforce bridge to Employee (IS_TICKET_AGENT_FOR). Handles tickets via ASSIGNED_TO (L1) and RESOLVED_BY (L2).
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(ta:StaffRole)-[:IS_TICKET_AGENT_FOR]->(u:Employee) WHERE t.organization_id = $organization_id AND t.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND t.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN u.first_name + ' ' + u.last_name AS agent, count(t) AS assigned_count ORDER BY assigned_count DESC LIMIT 10

name: Support Requester
description: Person who reported a ticket. Path: SupportCase-[:REPORTED_VIA]->SupportProfile-[:OVERLAY_OF]->Contact. Contact may also have Customer sublabel via contact_type.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase)-[:REPORTED_VIA]->(sp:SupportProfile)-[:OVERLAY_OF]->(ct:Contact) WHERE t.organization_id = $organization_id AND ct.cdp_id = $cdp_id RETURN count(t) AS tkt_total_tickets, avg(CASE WHEN t.csat_score IS NOT NULL THEN toFloat(t.csat_score) END) AS tkt_avg_csat_score

name: High Priority Open Tickets
description: Open tickets with priority in urgent/high.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase)-[:USES_STATUS]->(ts:CaseStatus) WHERE ts.is_terminal = false AND toLower(t.priority) IN ['urgent', 'high'] AND t.organization_id = $organization_id RETURN count(t) AS high_priority_open

name: SupportCase Note Volume
description: Volume of TicketNote on tickets. visibility distinguishes internal vs customer-visible.
cypher_template: MATCH (n:TicketNote) WHERE n.organization_id = $organization_id AND n.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND n.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN n.visibility AS visibility, count(n) AS note_volume

name: Outbound SupportCase Email
description: Emails sent to customers about tickets (OutboundEmail). kinds include ticket_created, ticket_reply, ticket_resolved.
cypher_template: MATCH (e:OutboundEmail)-[:SENT_FOR]->(t:SupportCase) WHERE e.organization_id = $organization_id AND e.created_at >= datetime($period_start) AND e.created_at < datetime($period_end) RETURN e.kind AS kind, count(e) AS email_volume

name: Knowledge Article
description: Published help content as KnowledgeArticle. Distinct from accounts KnowledgeDocument.
cypher_template: MATCH (a:KnowledgeArticle) WHERE a.organization_id = $organization_id AND a.status = 'Published' RETURN a.category AS category, count(a) AS articles, sum(a.views) AS total_views ORDER BY total_views DESC

name: SupportCase Dashboard KPIs
description: Cached org KPI snapshot on DashboardMetrics: open_tickets, on_hold, overdue, due_today, unassigned. Use for quick home answers; live SupportCase queries for authoritative analytics.
cypher_template: MATCH (dm:DashboardMetrics) WHERE dm.organization_id = $organization_id RETURN dm.open_tickets AS open_tickets, dm.overdue AS overdue, dm.due_today AS due_today, dm.unassigned AS unassigned, dm.captured_at AS captured_at

name: Client Account Tickets
description: Tickets filed by contacts under a B2B ClientAccount (ticketing.ticketing_accounts). Not CRM Account and not MyAccount Tenant.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase)-[:REPORTED_VIA]->(sp:SupportProfile)-[:OF_ACCOUNT]->(ca:ClientAccount) WHERE ca.organization_id = $organization_id AND ca.name = $account_name RETURN count(t) AS ticket_count, avg(CASE WHEN t.csat_score IS NOT NULL THEN toFloat(t.csat_score) END) AS avg_csat

name: Reopened Tickets
description: Tickets currently or historically in Reopened status (non-terminal). Indicates resolution quality issues.
cypher_template: MATCH (t:SupportCase)-[:USES_STATUS]->(ts:CaseStatus) WHERE t.organization_id = $organization_id AND ts.status = 'Reopened' RETURN count(t) AS reopened_tickets

name: SupportCase Automation Rule
description: Org AutomationRule that runs on ticket.created / ticket.updated to set priority, queue, assignee, or notify.
cypher_template: MATCH (r:AutomationRule) WHERE r.organization_id = $organization_id AND r.enabled = true RETURN r.name AS rule, r.event AS event, r.priority AS run_order ORDER BY r.priority

name: Website Traffic & Session Volume
description: Aggregated web sessions, pageviews, and bounce rate across tracked websites.
cypher_template: MATCH (v:Visit)-[:ON_SITE]->(s:TrackedSite) WHERE v.started_at >= datetime() AND v.started_at < datetime() RETURN s.site_url AS site, count(v) AS sessions, sum(v.pageview_count) AS pageviews, avg(v.duration_seconds) AS avg_duration_sec ORDER BY sessions DESC

name: Opportunity Win Rate
description: Percentage of closed opportunities won during the selected period.
cypher_template: MATCH (o:Opportunity) WHERE o.stage IN ["closed_won", "closed_lost"] AND o.closed_at >= datetime() AND o.closed_at < datetime() WITH count(o) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN o.stage = "closed_won" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won RETURN total, won, CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE toFloat(won)/total END AS win_rate

name: Sales Cycle Length
description: Average duration in days from opportunity creation to close.
cypher_template: MATCH (o:Opportunity) WHERE o.stage = "closed_won" AND o.closed_at >= datetime() AND o.closed_at < datetime() RETURN avg(duration.inDays(o.created_at, o.closed_at).days) AS avg_sales_cycle_days
